title: N5 · Unit 8

lesson.title: Casual talk
lesson.description: Plain forms for friends, と思う for opinions, and ないで for 'don't'.
lesson.canDo: Talk casually with a friend and give a simple opinion

grammar.title: Plain forms: how friends talk
grammar.explanation: With friends and family, Japanese switches to the plain form of the verb: 行きます → 行く, 行きません → 行かない, します → する, 来ます → 来る. Nouns and な adjectives take だ (or nothing) instead of です: 暇だよ, 雨だよ. A question is just rising intonation: 行く？ An invitation: 行かない？ (= 行きませんか). Much anime dialogue between friends is plain; use です/ます with people you don't know well.

grammar.title: と思う and ないで
grammar.explanation: Plain form + と思う/と思います = 'I think that…': 雨が降ると思う. Plain negative + で (ください) = 'please don't': 心配しないでください.
grammar.example: 明日は雨が降ると思います。
grammar.translation: I think it will rain tomorrow.

dialogue.title: A barbecue invitation
dialogue.scene: Hana calls out to you in the corridor, as friends do.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.line: レンさんとバーベキューをする。{一緒|いっしょ}に{行|い}かない？
lines.romaji: Ren-san to bābekyū o suru. Issho ni ikanai?
lines.meaning: I'm having a barbecue with Ren. Want to come?

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: いいね。でも、{明日|あした}は{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}ると{思|おも}う。
lines.romaji: Ii ne. Demo, ashita wa ame ga furu to omou.
lines.meaning: Sounds good. But I think it'll rain tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.line: {大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}。レンさんのカフェでする。
lines.romaji: Daijōbu. Ren-san no kafe de suru.
lines.meaning: It's fine. We're doing it at Ren's café.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: じゃあ、{何|なに}か{持|も}って{行|い}く？
lines.meaning: Then do I need to bring anything?

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.line: ううん、{心配|しんぱい}しないで。

exercises.explain: レンさんのカフェでする.

exercises.prompt: Which is the casual way to say 一緒に行きませんか?
options: {一緒|いっしょ}に{行|い}かない？
{一緒|いっしょ}に{行|い}きない？
{一緒|いっしょ}に{行|い}くませんか？
exercises.explain: 行きません → 行かない; as a question with rising tone it's an invitation.

exercises.context: Give your opinion about tomorrow's weather.
exercises.line: {明日|あした}は{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}る＿＿{思|おも}います。
exercises.meaning: I think it will rain tomorrow.
exercises.explain: Plain form + と思います: 'I think that…'.

exercises.context: Your close friend asks in casual speech. You are free; answer in the same casual style.
options: ううん、{暇|ひま}じゃない。
exercises.explain: うん + 暇だよ: casual yes, matching how you were asked. 暇じゃない would mean you're busy.

exercises.prompt: What do you think the weather will do?

exercises.explain: Plain negative しない + で + ください.

exercises.context: Tell a friend Ren is coming too. Use the plain form, as friends do.
exercises.explain: Plain 来る + よ. 来ますよ means the same but is the polite form.

exercises.prompt: Hana asks you to bring food.
exercises.explain: ううん、心配しないで: no need.

letter.title: A message from Hana
letter.subject: 明日ね
letter.question: Where will the barbecue be held?

tasks.explain: レンさんも来る: Ren is coming too.
